{{Quote|Anything the great Biggs Darklighter could do, I can do. I'm as good as he ever was.''"<br />"''Well, then why don't you thread the Stone Needle, like Biggs did? That ought to shave five seconds, or better, off your time.|Fixer and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="A Wind">{{SWRadio|A Wind to Shake the Stars}}</ref>}}
The '''Stone Needle''', otherwise known as the '''Eye of the Needle''',<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> was a 60 meter tall rock formation in [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The formation was a tall stone tower with a "loop" rock on top of it situated in the middle of a ditch. The loop, lined with jagged rock teeth, was just large enough to allow small [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] to pass through. Early explorers speculated that the rock formation had been carved by extinct, native Tatooine beings, but no evidence to substantiate this theory was ever found.<ref name="Technical Journal">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:SOTE_Beggars_Canyon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|"Threading the Needle"]]
[[Swoop/Legends|Swoop]] bikers showed off their [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills by "[[threading the needle]]," or flying their swoops through the loop, a maneuver that required high speeds.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friends would often pilot their [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]] through the Stone Needle while growing up on Tatooine. Days before the death of his [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|aunt]] and [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]], Skywalker challenged his friend Fixer through the bottleneck. With another of his friends, [[Windy Starkiller|Windy Marstrap]], riding along with him, Skywalker beat Fixer through the loop. Frightened by Skywalker's near-suicidal maneuvering, Windy squealed through the whole race. Skywalker later admitted to himself that he brought Windy along to prove to him that he was cut out for more than the simple life of a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]]. Luke's success piloting through the Stone Needle convinced him that he was [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] material.<ref name="SWJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>

A [[1 ABY/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Skywalker led several members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] on a leisure run through Beggar's Canyon, introducing them to the Needle.<ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

Years later in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Skywalker evaded a group of assassins hired by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] by leading them on a swoop chase through Beggar's Canyon, and finally through the Eye of the Needle. Skywalker survived the maneuver, as he had many times before, unlike his final pursuer, who crashed into the needle and died in the fiery blaze.<ref name="SOTE" />
